en.t: At last, the man began to cry.

units.source_text: 起先还强忍克制着，呜呜咽咽，不一会儿就号啕大哭起来。

en.t: At first he still tried desperately to hold himself back, sobbing under his breath, but before long he broke into loud, uncontrollable weeping.

units.source_text: 可怜的崩溃感觉里，男人恐怖得直打哆嗦，此命休矣。

en.t: In that pitiful feeling of collapse, the man trembled with terror; his life was over.

units.source_text: 谁也没瞧见，没有办法了……

en.t: No one had seen it; there was nothing to be done now...

units.source_text: 实际上这种事，没有任何手续也做得成，太不公平了……

en.t: In fact, something like this could be done without any procedure at all; it was terribly unfair...

units.source_text: 死刑犯死的时候，也还能留个记录下来……

en.t: Even when a condemned prisoner dies, some record can still be left behind...
No matter how loudly he shouted and screamed...
No one saw anything; what rotten luck!
